_readme: Corporate pump catalogue for Plumb_PumpSelect and Plumb_BoosterSet. Ships EMPTY on purpose: STING does not invent pump data. Add entries from manufacturer curves here, or per project in <project>/_BIM_COORD/pump_catalogue.json (same shape; project entries replace corporate ones with the same manufacturer + model). An entry needs ratedFlowLps > 0 and ratedHeadM > 0 to be considered. The duty point is written to the pump even when nothing here matches it.
